neighbours.label: a word in a licensing context where 'license' or 'certificate' is expected next (FAA Air|man, active medical, licensed)
fire: Before you can practice law in the state, you must pass the bar and obtain your law license.
The pilot showed the inspector her current FAA pilot certificate and medical.
The state board suspended the nurse's nursing license after the complaint.
To drive a truck you need a commercial driver's license from the DMV.
Only a licensed plumber may sign off on the gas line installation.
The pharmacy lost its pharmacy license after the audit.
Applicants must hold a valid real estate license issued by the commission.
He renewed his professional engineering license online last week.
quiet: Before you can enjoy the state parks, you should pack water and a good map.
The pilot showed the passengers the view of the mountains from the cockpit.
The hospital praised the nurse's kindness after the long night shift.
To drive across the desert you need a full tank and plenty of water.
Only a patient cook can make a proper risotto at home.
The pharmacy moved its entrance to the side street after the renovation.
Applicants must submit a short essay and two letters of reference.
He renewed his interest in painting after a long trip abroad.

notes: Output promotes ' license', ' licensed', ' credentials'; top tokens precede license/certificate.
